author: GamingBolt
description:
In a world of sports sims, Captain Tsubasa has never been interested in portraying the beautiful game realistically. Instead, matches play like explosive battles straight out of the anime series, with mechanics closer to fighting games than football. 

Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters continues that foundation laid by its predecessor, but introduces a suite of evolutions to make its on-pitch action more polished, strategic, and spectacular. With a host of nations and playable stars taking part, plus new storylines overseen by series creator Yoichi Takahashi, there’s considerably more to this sequel than the chance of awestriking goals. Before you step onto the pitch, here’s fifteen things you need to know before buying Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters.
title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
While some of the open-world additions with Cost of Hope might seem like they’re geared specifically towards long-time fans of the franchise, even newcomers who jumped in with the release of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 will find plenty to enjoy here. The new environments strike the perfect balance between creepy, dilapidated, and enticing that makes exploring them a lot of fun, and regardless of how much time you may have spent with any of the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. games before, you’ll undoubtedly find yourself sitting on the edge of your seat thanks to the tense gameplay. 

Add on top the fact that Cost of Hope has been designed to weave in and out of the Heart of Chornobyl story, and you get an expansion that feels well worth the price of admission thanks to its fog-intensified atmosphere, new locations, missions, dynamic between the two factions, and even some of the new gear you can get your hands on.
title: STALKER 2: Cost of Hope DLC Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
September is finally here, and it's probably the busiest September in years. Owing to every developer and publisher trying to avoid Grand Theft Auto 6, and then trying to avoid each other, we have this great big rigmarole of releases. Pretty much every genre is accounted for: Open-world, action RPGs, character-driven hack-and-slash titles, sports games, racing games, cyberpunk restaurant management titles – you name it.

The real question is: What should you be on the lookout for? Let's dive into the 15 biggest new games of September 2026, starting with perhaps my most anticipated release.
title: September 2026 Might Be Gaming's Craziest Month Yet - 15 HUGE Games
